s1.title: What HUSTDOCU is
s1.body:
HUSTDOCU is where students of Hanoi University of Science and Technology share study materials: exams, slides, solutions, notes and syllabi.

It is a student project, not an official channel of the university.

s2.title: Accounts
s2.body: Only school-issued email addresses can register. You are responsible for activity on your account and must not share sign-in codes.

s3.title: Sharing rights and copyright
s3.body:
By uploading, you confirm you are the author or have the right to share the document for non-commercial study purposes.

Do not upload textbooks or books on sale, internal materials marked not for distribution, or other people's work without permission.

Copyright holders can request removal on the takedown page.

s4.title: Moderation
s4.body: Every document goes through automatic checks (format, duplicates, malware, content) and then a moderator before it is published. Moderators may reject, request changes or remove violating documents and will state the reason.

s5.title: Prohibited behaviour
s5.body:
Uploading malware, advertising, abusive content or other people's personal data; gaming downloads or reputation; scraping the site with automated tools.

Violations may lead to removal, reputation penalties, an upload ban or account suspension.

s6.title: Limitation of liability
s6.body: User-contributed documents may contain mistakes. Check them against your textbooks and lecturers. Do not use the library to cheat in exams.

s1.title: What we store
s1.body:
Your school email, name, school, cohort, student ID (if you enter it), the documents you share, and your search and download history.

IP addresses are only stored hashed, to prevent abuse.

s2.title: Who sees your information
s2.body:
Viewers see the uploader's display name unless you choose to stay anonymous. Moderators always see the uploader in order to handle violations.

We do not sell or share data with third parties.

s3.title: Email
s3.body: We send sign-in codes and moderation results to your school email.

s4.title: Your rights
s4.body: You can edit your profile at any time. To delete your account or get a copy of your data, contact the administrators via the takedown page.
